note_text: Patient with adenocarcinoma of the left lung, clinical stage IIIA, T2N2M0. Started on carboplatin and pemetrexed. ECOG 1. EGFR exon 19 deletion positive.
Invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast, stage IIB, T2N1M0. ER positive, PR positive, HER2 3+. Plan: trastuzumab based regimen.
Prostate adenocarcinoma, Gleason 7, clinical stage II. PSA 8.4. Active surveillance discussed.
Colon adenocarcinoma, stage IV with hepatic metastases, T4N2M1. KRAS mutant. FOLFOX initiated. ECOG 2.
